description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

Assured is building a new generation of products for the insurance industry. We’re helping people move through the claims process with less confusion and giving the teams supporting them better ways to get things done.

We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer to help shape our core AI assistant experience. Our assistant helps claims adjusters understand a claim, get answers, create tasks, conduct investigations, and manage automated communications. As its capabilities grow, you’ll help make it a clear, intuitive, and dependable part of an adjuster’s day.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Product Design. You’ll join the team building this experience, lead design across key areas of the product, and help shape its broader direction. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and other designers from early problem framing through launch and iteration.

The opportunity is to bring the ease and polish of the best consumer products to complex professional work. You’ll shape how conversation, information, and actions fit together, developing the structures and interaction patterns that make an increasingly capable assistant feel coherent and easy to use.

🎯 What you’ll do

  • Help shape the direction of our AI assistant and lead design across core interactions and workflows, from asking a question to completing a task.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering early to frame problems, explore possibilities, and shape how the assistant behaves.

  • Build a deep understanding of adjusters’ work, including how they gather context, investigate issues, communicate, and decide what to do next.

  • Design how messaging, claim information, and task workflows connect, helping people move naturally between conversation and more structured interactions.

  • Develop reusable interaction patterns and information structures that support new capabilities while keeping the overall experience consistent.

  • Move from exploration and interactive prototyping into detailed interaction and visual design, partnering with Engineering through implementation and refinement.

  • Work directly with users and customers to test ideas, learn from real use, and improve how confidently and effectively people get work done.

🧠 What we’re looking for

  • Experience leading design work in AI assistants, messaging, collaboration, productivity tools, or similarly interactive products.

  • Strong craft across interaction design, information architecture, and visual design, with a portfolio that shows how you bring clarity and polish to complex experiences.

  • Systems thinking: the ability to connect individual interactions to a coherent product model and develop patterns that extend as a product grows.

  • Thoughtful judgment about human–AI interaction, including how people understand responses, review actions, recover from mistakes, and maintain control.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering from discovery through shipped experiences, using prototypes and user feedback to make thoughtful tradeoffs.

  • The ability to create clarity, build alignment, and take responsibility for the quality of the experience while collaborating closely with other designers.

✨ You might be a great fit if...

You care about the rhythm of a conversation, the clarity of a response, and the details that make a product feel natural to use. You’re equally interested in the structure underneath: how information is organized, how tasks connect, and how new capabilities fit into the experience.

You enjoy bringing consumer product craft to tools people rely on at work. You can move between exploring a new interaction, defining a reusable pattern, and refining the small details that make it work well in practice.

Insurance experience is not required. Curiosity, strong product judgment, and the ability to make unfamiliar, complex problems understandable matter much more.

Benefits:

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

👶 Family Leave: Maternity & paternity

📈 401(k) Contribution: Assured contributes 3% of your income, even if you don't contribute

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

🤝 Team events & Offsites: We're remote, but we regularly get together

**We have been made aware of individuals falsely posing as recruiters from Assured Insurance Technologies Inc. Please note that we only contact candidates from official @assured.claims email addresses and all interviews are conducted through verified company channels. If you are unsure whether a message is legitimate, please contact us directly at recruiting-ops@assured.claims before sharing any personal information**
